plan.title: Single-stage auction with optional terms acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the single-stage event flow.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation so publishing is available.
Set the event type to a reverse auction with a standard buy-auction strategy.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Select the buy/reverse-auction pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Populate the remaining required pricing-sheet values.
Set the first line item's delivery location.

args.goal: On the single-stage buyer create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave the mandatory-terms switch unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen.

steps.note: Configure the two optional event-wise terms, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the first clause is present after saving the terms.
Confirm the second clause is present after saving the terms.
Invite the available QA test vendor for the event.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Confirm the first optional clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the second optional clause is shown to the vendor.
Have the vendor accept the first clause.
Have the vendor accept the second clause.
Submit a bid of 100 for every line after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's submitted response.
Open the buyer's event overview where the event terms are visible.
Confirm the first clause is visible on the buyer side.
Confirm the second clause is visible on the buyer side.
